meta.title: ETF Overlap Calculator | US & HK Stocks
meta.description: Free online ETF overlap analysis tool. Compare holdings overlap between US and HK ETFs to optimize your portfolio and avoid duplication.
meta.keywords: ETF, Overlap, Holdings, Portfolio, US Stocks, HK Stocks, Diversification

error.min_two: Please select at least two ETFs to compare
error.failed: Analysis failed, please check network or try again later

ready_state.title: Ready
ready_state.desc: Select a market and add at least two ETFs on the left, then click 'Analyze' to see their holdings overlap.
ready_state.note: Holdings come from issuers' official files first, then SEC N-PORT. If neither is available only the top 10 are shown and flagged.

result.title: Analysis Result
result.note: * Data from issuer holdings files / SEC N-PORT; falls back to Yahoo Finance top 10 (flagged) when full holdings are unavailable.
result.incomplete_banner: Full holdings unavailable for: {{tickers}}. Overlap is likely understated.
result.sec_note: SEC quarterly filing; may lag by months

reason.top10_only: Full holdings unavailable; only the top 10 from Yahoo are shown
reason.truncated: Source returned only part of the holdings
reason.low_coverage: Weights sum is low; some assets may be missing
